column1: # Short English glosses for the word-by-word line under the padachheda (tools/gloss.py).
# lemma<TAB>gloss. The lemma is the DCS base form (IAST). Write a noun in the singular, a verb in
# its plain form ("say", "be born"): gloss.py adds the plural, "in"/"of"/"O", the person and the tense.
# a+b<TAB>gloss: a whole compound, by its members' lemmas (mahat+bāhu: "mighty-armed").
# Words not listed here take the corpus's sense or the first dictionary meaning.
# These glosses are written for this app (not copied from any translation); edit freely, then
# pronouns (gloss.py gives case forms: me, my, in me ...)
# compounds as a whole (members' lemmas joined by +)
# verbs (plain form; "be X" for a state: be born, be deluded)
# more words, from the list of words used 3+ times
